## McHardy et al. (2026), beta Vinet

`zirconium_beta_mchardy_2026_vinet_1` · Executable

Reproduction: **reproduced** · [Reconstruction report](../reconstruction-reports/zirconium_beta.md#record-zirconium_beta_mchardy_2026_vinet_1)

**Source finding:** The beta-phase V0 is explicitly an extrapolated fixed fit parameter.

Automatic selection for equilibrium calculations.

| Component | Parameter | Value | Reported error | Fixed |

- **Origin of the parameterization:** experimental
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** McHardy; Storm; Lonsdale; Roy; McMahon
    - **Year:** 2026
    - **Title:** Phase transitions in Zr to 240 GPa
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 113
    - **Locator:** 174115
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/zp3m-kjpc
- **Reference temperature (K):** 300.0
- **Reported pressure coverage (GPa):** \[35.0, 240.0\]
- **Reported temperature coverage (K):** \[300.0, 300.0\]

The beta-phase fit uses the constrained value V0 = 22.6 Å³/atom, stored per conventional bcc cell (×2). The paper cautions that this far-extrapolated reference volume has no direct physical significance.
